Punate

confidential. tentral college Fayette, Mo

Men & reoch.

jany hera Dear Sir. Please foward the encloved papers to the county clerk before Friday. We received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I semain, with great respect, your obedient scrvant. The committe will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full. Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before Friday. He received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with 4198
